title: Long-term prediction of climate change impacts on indoor particle pollution – case study of a residential building in Germany
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,1688-1703
DOI: 10.1039/D4EM00663A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jiangyue Zhao, Tunga Salthammer, Alexandra Schieweck, Erik Uhde, Tareq Hussein
The Indoor Air Quality Climate Change (IAQCC) model was applied to predict the long-term impact of atmospheric changes on indoor particle concentrations based on different climate scenarios.
